changes.legacy_reload: A private one-use reload grant may retain the validated legacy directory and advertised artifact paths; ordinary new connections use the per-user root.
changes.terminal_reopen: Only permission-denied device-node reopening tries /dev/tty. The new descriptor must identify the current controlling session and foreground group; Linux additionally requires equal TIOCGDEV identity.
changes.descriptor_flags: The reopened output descriptor is independently nonblocking and close-on-exec. Inherited descriptors are never changed.

validation_scope.runtime: Actual Linux kernel UID changes and newly allocated PTYs; no account creation or authenticated service login.
validation_scope.compiled_by: Coordinated integrated build; this subtask did not start Cargo.
limitations: The complete integrated release gates are tracked separately by the parent workflow.
The isolated cross-UID PTY regression ran on Linux; other platforms retain their existing output defaults or portable terminal checks.
